task_description: Implement GitHub Issue #20 (UX: game schedule / start-time display): preserve the game start time (currently truncated to date-only in aggregation) as new OPTIONAL shared fields without changing the existing `date` field (criterion 1); display start times in the viewer's local timezone via Intl.DateTimeFormat with EN/JA formatting (criterion 2); correctly handle time-TBD games (criterion 3); plus the proposed today/tomorrow + countdown section and a client-side .ics calendar download. Spans shared (types) + backend (aggregation) + frontend; no infra/IAM change. Incremental commits on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site; orchestrator owns push/PR/deploy.

nonblocking_notes: hasNoTimeOfDay treats a legitimate exactly-00:00:00Z first pitch as TBD (documented trade-off; explicit startTimeTBD flag is the reliable signal).
A game bucketed 'today' but already started shows a 0d 0h 0m countdown (minor display oddity).
Midnight-UTC placeholder assumption asserted by synthetic test only, not a live not-yet-scheduled payload.

verification.summary: npm run build (shared->backend->frontend->infra) green. npm test green: shared 34, backend 94, frontend 120, infra 8. npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend 38 passed (incl. 4 new game-times tests). npm run synth exit 0 (no AWS calls; only benign nodejs20.x deprecation + feature-flag notices, pre-existing). Reviewed the new tests (gameTime.test.ts, upcomingGames.test.ts, ics.test.ts, aggregate.test.ts additions): they exercise the real functions with fixed inputs and exact assertions (UTC-vs-local date-shift, EN/JA locale divergence, TBD/undefined/unparseable paths, fixed-string .ics DTSTART/DTEND/SUMMARY escaping, aggregation startTime verbatim + timeTbd rule) and would fail if the implementation were reverted. No Dockerfile build path used (host-based validation). No infra/IAM change.
